name: Sync Figma Design Variables

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 4 * * 1-5"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch Figma Variables & Editor Info
        env:
          FIGMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.FIGMA_API_KEY }}
          FIGMA_FILE_KEY: ZEm9L8DlrXdHWuB1zpCZn4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          curl -s -H "X-Figma-Token: $FIGMA_API_KEY" \
            "https://api.figma.com/v1/files/$FIGMA_FILE_KEY/variables/local" > variables_raw.json
          VERSIONS=$(curl -s -H "X-Figma-Token: $FIGMA_API_KEY" \
            "https://api.figma.com/v1/files/$FIGMA_FILE_KEY/versions")

          LAST_EDITOR=$(echo "$VERSIONS" | jq -r '.versions[0].user.handle')
          LAST_MODIFIED=$(echo "$VERSIONS" | jq -r '.versions[0].created_at')

          jq --arg editor "$LAST_EDITOR" --arg modified "$LAST_MODIFIED" \
            '. + { _meta: { last_editor: $editor, last_modified: $modified } }' \
            variables_raw.json > tokens.json

          rm variables_raw.json
          echo "LAST_EDITOR=$LAST_EDITOR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "LAST_MODIFIED=$LAST_MODIFIED" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Commit if changed
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add tokens.json

          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "$(printf "chore: sync figma tokens\n\nLast edited by: %s\nLast modified: %s" "$LAST_EDITOR" "$LAST_MODIFIED")"
            git push origin HEAD
          fi
